title: How To Edit The Default Search Results Radius For The Site | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Edit The Default Search Results Radius For The Site Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682672 When a user does a search on the site for a specific location, the default is to display all members within a 50 mile (or kilometer, depending on the settings of the site) radius from the searched location. To edit this radius, please follow these steps: Navigate to: Settings >> General Settings >> Search Settings Select the preferred number of miles (or kilometers, depending on the settings of the site) from the drop-down: Select from the following choices: Additional information: Settings » Advanced Settings » Bounds And Radius Location Searches For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
